item.title: Solved: How to Set Timeout for Python Requests and Handle Delays
item.description: When gathering statistics on a list of websites using Python’s requests library, one challenge faced by developers is managing timeouts effectively. Here’s an exploration of various methods to set and handle timeouts in your requests, ensuring that your code doesn’t get stuck during the process. Below is a practical guide with various solutions to set a timeout of 10 seconds for a request, while also maintaining the rich features that requests provides.
